The '''Tibanna mynock''' was a highly adaptable [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Mynock/Legends|mynock]] that could be found on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and other [[Planet/Legends|planets]] where [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas was present. The Tibanna mynocks resembled normal mynocks, but possessed specialized gills that allowed them to breath air that was highly concentrated with toxic fumes. They also consumed Tibanna and their bodies contained pockets of the gas. In about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] inadvertently disturbed a group of six Tibanna mynocks that were perched on top of a Tibanna container in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on Bespin, causing the mynocks to attack a nearby group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents.
